articles.summary: iAltA, a private markets infrastructure company, today announced the launch of Quorim, a new company designed to modernize infrastructure across private credit markets. Established through a strategic partnership with Tradeweb, a leading global operator of electronic marketplaces, Quorim combines deep private markets expertise with proven experience operating large-scale financial market networks.
articles.title: iAltA Launches Quorim to Power Next-Generation Infrastructure for Private Credit

articles.summary: BILLY HULT is Chief Executive Officer of Tradeweb Markets Inc. and a member of the board. Since joining Tradeweb in 2000, he has helped transform the company from a single-product platform for U.S. Treasuries into a leading global electronic marketplace across multiple asset classes. Mr. Hult became CEO in 2023 after serving 15 years as President — a tenure that included playing a key role in Tradeweb’s landmark IPO in 2019.
articles.title: Interview with the CEO: Billy Hult, Tradeweb

articles.summary: NEW YORK – August 6, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported total trading volume for the month of July 2026 of $67.5 trillion (tn). Average daily volume ("ADV") for the month was $2.9tn, an increase of 23.3 percent (%) year-over-year ("YoY").
articles.title: Tradeweb Reports July 2026 Total Trading Volume of $67.5 Trillion and Average Daily Volume of $2.9 Trillion

articles.summary: After a relatively subdued June, global government bond markets experienced a sell-off in July, with 10-year benchmark yields recording double-digit increases. Those for Greece saw the largest move, climbing 40 basis points to end the month at 3.89%.
articles.title: Tradeweb Government Bond Update – July 2026

articles.summary: Trading activity on the Tradeweb European-listed ETF marketplace reached EUR 77.5 billion in July, an increase of approximately 29% year-over-year. Transactions completed via Tradeweb’s Automated Intelligent Execution (AiEX) tool represented a record 96% of tickets and accounted for 32% of notional volume on the platform.
